chapter: Instruments, tenors and the current band
title: Audience reception of the new album on campuses
summary: The album is getting a great reception, especially in colleges where students asked about it for months before.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: Good, good. Are you finding tremendous reception of this as you have been touring, playing the music?

Yeah, we've had great reception. Now it's just starting to get into the hinterlands where we usually spend our time. And finding out some of the more youthful reservoirs, like I suppose in colleges, that they are now asking, and when you play it you get a tremendous reception. And maybe they consider it the hippest thing that's happened since Seven-Up.

Has this stimulated -- if you perceive this evidence, anyway, that it's gotten these young people interested in some of the other things you've done that they haven't been exposed to before, because of this introduction to you?
Well, I think it's a little premature about that, because we've been into schools for so long, where
it's all happening, and anything new we do, they're aware of it before we do it. They've been asking questions about this album for six or eight months.
